items.name: Summit Cube Day 2020

venue.name: Dillon Valley Elementary School
venue.address: 108 Deer Path Rd, Dillon, CO 80435, USA
venue.details: Competitors should enter through the front doors and stay in either the gym or the cafeteria while in the building.

items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. **Square-1 is the main event at this competition!** This is one of the highest cubing competitions in North America at over 9,000 feet from sea level. The venue is located a long ways outside of Colorado Springs to reach new competitors in Colorado. Due to limited space and seating, we can only accomodate 75 competitors. Due to this, competitors are asked to keep guests to a minimum to ensure that there is room for the competitors. Competitors should register early to ensure a spot. All competitors will have a lanyard with assignments and rounds that you are competing in there when you arrive. Pets are not allowed inside of the venue unless they are service animals.
